pricing.heroSub: Model electroporation, acoustic resonance, and impedance spectroscopy. Design protocols, compare cell populations, and run AI-assisted optimizations, all without touching physical hardware.
pricing.valuePhysicsDesc: Schwan transmembrane voltage, SAR thermal model, Maxwell-Garnett impedance, and acoustic resonance, all computed live in your browser with PhD-level accuracy.
pricing.valueStorageDesc: Every parameter sweep, selectivity window, and AI optimization is saved to your experiment log. Export full CSV reports with Materials and Methods text in one click.
pricing.valueAiDesc: Submit your current protocol and target window to the AI optimizer. It returns ranked field/frequency/pulse combinations tuned for maximum selectivity ratio.
pricing.plansSub: Every plan starts with a free tier. Upgrade when your protocol complexity demands it.
pricing.costsSub: Credits are consumed only by compute-intensive operations. Browsing, viewing, and parameter tuning are always free.
pricing.ctaHeadline: Ready to run your first virtual protocol?
pricing.ctaSub: No hardware required. No installation. Start modelling in seconds.
pricing.faqA1: Credits are consumed by compute-intensive operations like selectivity sweeps, impedance sessions, and AI optimizations. Simple parameter changes, chart viewing, and protocol reading are always free.
pricing.faqA2: Credits reset on the first of each calendar month. They do not roll over, so use them for your most important protocols each cycle.
pricing.faqQ3: Can I upgrade or downgrade at any time?
pricing.faqA3: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately and your balance is topped up to the new quota. Downgrades apply at the next reset date.
pricing.faqA4: All experiment data is scoped to your organisation workspace. Other users cannot access your protocol snapshots, sweeps, or reports.
pricing.faqA5: Credit and debit cards via Stripe. Enterprise invoicing is available on request.
